hook: Patel has run product at four different points along enterprise software's evolution, content management at Doculabs, cloud file sync at EMC and Syncplicity, cloud content at Box, and now security, collaboration, and AI infrastructure at Cisco, rising to President and Chief Product Officer as the company repositions its networking core around AI.
name: Jeetu Patel

quote.text: I fundamentally believe AI is the most profound shift we have experienced in humanity and everything I do today at Cisco, I try to make sure I approach from an AI-first lens.
quote.context: Jeetu Patel, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco

primary.name: Jeetu Patel, official executive bio, Cisco Newsroom

timeline.event: Moves from Mumbai, India to the United States
Joins Doculabs, rising to President by 2010
Joins EMC as CTO of the Information Intelligence Group
timeline.impact: Moves into cloud and big-data strategy leadership

timeline.event: Leads EMC's acquisition of Syncplicity, then runs it as GM and CEO
timeline.impact: Builds one of the fastest-growing enterprise file-sync businesses

timeline.event: Joins Box as SVP of Platform and Chief Strategy Officer
timeline.impact: Begins five-year tenure shaping Box's platform and product strategy

timeline.event: Joins Cisco to lead Security and Collaboration
timeline.impact: Takes on Webex and Cisco's security portfolio

timeline.event: Named President and Chief Product Officer of Cisco

quick_facts: President and Chief Product Officer of Cisco, leading Security and Collaboration before taking company-wide product authority
Led the EMC acquisition and later divestiture of Syncplicity, then became Chief Product Officer of Box
Serves on the boards of JLL and previously Equinix and HackerRank
Career built across Doculabs, EMC, Box, and Cisco spanning more than three decades

achievements.title: Leading EMC's acquisition of Syncplicity (2012) and its later divestiture (2015)
achievements.impact: Ran the enterprise file-sync business as General Manager and Chief Executive with full P&L responsibility, earning leader rankings in the Gartner Magic Quadrant and Forrester Wave, then led its sale to Skyview Capital.

achievements.title: Chief Product Officer and Chief Strategy Officer, Box (2017-2020)
achievements.impact: Took charge of all product at Box after joining in 2015 to lead its platform business, shaping Box's cloud content management strategy.

achievements.title: Leading Cisco's Security and Collaboration business units (2020-2024)
achievements.impact: Ran the SVP/EVP and GM role over Security and Collaboration, including Webex, reporting to CEO Chuck Robbins.

achievements.title: Named Cisco President and Chief Product Officer (2025)
achievements.impact: Given product authority across Cisco's full portfolio, positioning the company's networking business as core AI infrastructure.

achievements.title: Board service at JLL, Equinix, and HackerRank
achievements.impact: Brought enterprise product and AI strategy experience to governance roles at a global real estate services firm, a data center operator, and a technical hiring platform.
